aliases: シンニンギア・スペシオサ

light.best.quote: They need bright indoor light with no direct sunlight and constant moisture.

light.min.quote: Bright, indirect light is necessary to keep gloxinias in flower.

light.directSun.quote: They need bright indoor light with no direct sunlight

temperature.minC.quote: They are "warm loving" plants that grow best at a nighttime temperature of 65 °F or warmer.

temperature.idealC.quote: They are "warm loving" plants that grow best at a nighttime temperature of 65 °F or warmer. The preferred daytime temperature is 75 °F.

watering.growing.quote: Gloxinias should never be allowed to dry out, even slightly.

watering.winter.quote: After the second bloom reduce watering until the foliage dies back.

watering.winter.reason: 花のあとは葉が枯れて球根で休眠するため、乾かす

tips.ja: 水やりで葉をぬらさない。冷たい水で葉が傷む。
tips.quote: Leaves may be damaged by cold water, so keep water off of the foliage.

tips.ja: 水のやりすぎで根腐れする。
tips.quote: Gloxinia may develop root rot from overwatering.
